## Statement · **draft**
Let $L/K$ be a field extension and $H \le \operatorname{Aut}(L/K)$ a subgroup of the group of $K$-automorphisms. The set

$L^{H} := \{\, x \in L : \sigma(x) = x \ \text{for all } \sigma \in H \,\}$

is the **fixed field** of $H$. It is a subfield of $L$, and $K \subseteq L^{H} \subseteq L$.
